body: Interesting dito ang gap between knowing and acting. Kapag matagal nang nasa bahay ang appliance at wala namang nangyari, madaling gawing evidence ang personal history: ‘okay naman for years.’ Pero ang recall is asking us to accept a less intuitive idea: low-frequency risk can remain real kahit never mo pa itong personally experienced. Hindi kailangan matakot sa bawat appliance; ang mature response is proportional—verify the exact model, then act decisively only if matched. Safety without panic, caution without denial.

claims.text: Long trouble-free personal experience can make a recall warning feel less urgent even when an officially identified low-frequency hazard remains relevant.
claims.basis: Behavioral interpretation of the article's documented active recalls, fire hazard, and low recovery rates; not a claim about any specific owner's psychology.
